lines.en: I travel along the seams of the floor tiles.

lines.zh: 我的身体没有骨头，只有形。
lines.en: My body has no bones, only shape.

lines.zh: 我滑行时，灰尘被推开一条线。
lines.en: As I slide, I part the dust in a line.

lines.zh: 我绕过一枚掉落的钉子。
lines.en: I go around a dropped nail.
I move very quietly.
I squeeze under the door gap.

lines.zh: 我在墙角和墙角的交点停了一下。
lines.en: I pause at the junction of two walls.

lines.zh: 我测了测两块石砖的距离。
lines.en: I measure the gap between two stones.
My surface clings to the ground.

lines.zh: 我顺着台阶的边缘下去。
lines.en: I slip down along the edge of the steps.

lines.zh: 我每走一段就换一次形状。
lines.en: Every so often I change shape.
I move together with my shadow.

lines.zh: 我静止着，像地上的一点污迹。
lines.en: I lie still, like a spot on the floor.
I am sorting the sounds I have heard.

lines.zh: 我可以整夜摊着，不必合眼。
lines.en: I can lie spread all night without closing an eye.

lines.zh: 我的边缘微微鼓起，又平了。
lines.en: My edge swells, then smooths flat.

lines.zh: 光落在我身上，被我吸进去。
lines.en: Light falls on me and I draw it in.

lines.zh: 我在计算这间屋子的体积。
lines.en: I am calculating the volume of this room.

lines.zh: 有个声音反复出现，我记下了。
lines.en: A sound repeats. I have noted it.
I spread slowly, then draw in.

lines.zh: 编号刻在我体内，不刻在外。
lines.en: My number is carved inside me, not outside.

lines.zh: 这里很旧，木头一直在响。
lines.en: This place is old; the wood never stops creaking.
I press myself as thin as I can.
I wait for the one who summoned me.

lines.zh: 风从窗缝进来，我跟着动。
lines.en: Wind enters at the window seam; I move with it.
My surface reflects the ceiling.
I am not sleepy. Only slow.

lines.zh: 这个位置很好，能看到门。
lines.en: This spot is good. I can see the door.
I am at your feet, looking up.
Are you the one who summoned me?
You carry no weapon.
I have scanned your body.
Your heart beats sixty-eight times a minute.
Only a sole's thickness separates us.
You moved your foot away. Thank you.
I await a command.
If you say nothing, I will stay.
My edge lifts toward you.
You are not afraid. I am surprised.
I have memorized your footsteps.
If you go far, I will follow.

lines.zh: 我不会伤害你，除非你动手。
lines.en: I will not harm you unless you strike first.

lines.zh: 我的身体被压出一个坑。
lines.en: My body takes a dent.
Scatter, then come back together.

lines.zh: 被削掉的一角，正在长回。
lines.en: The corner sliced off is growing back.
I retreat to the corner.
The sensation runs through all of me.
I have grown thinner.
For a moment I cannot hold shape.

lines.zh: 让我摊平一会儿，再聚拢。
lines.en: Let me lie flat a moment, then gather myself.

lines.zh: 这一击的角度，我存下来了。
lines.en: I have stored the angle of that blow.
I swell back slowly.
I need to eat nothing at all.
That object gives no light.
I come close, then withdraw.
That means nothing to me.
You have held it out a long while. I do not move.
I respond only to light.

lines.zh: 我很小，可我一击两百五。
lines.en: I'm tiny, but my blow hits two-fifty.
I have its shape recorded.
There is nothing usable in it.
Just put your hand down.
You step down and I become thinner.
I slide out from under your sole.
You barely felt me.
I yield and retreat to the wall.
My shape carries an imprint.
I absorbed the impact.
I move to your other foot.
Do not step a second time.
I have no weight; I cannot hurt you.
Step away and I can spread out.
I have no sex at all.

lines.zh: 两个同类型碰到一起，会合并。
lines.en: Two of my type, meeting, merge.

lines.zh: 合并后我还是我，只是更厚。
lines.en: After merging I am still me, only thicker.
Then we separate.
This is not called breeding.

lines.zh: 我们没有后代，只有延续。
lines.en: We have no offspring, only continuation.
It stayed beside me, very quiet.
We did not speak.
After a while it left.
I am alone again.
I fold around it and carry it off.
Small enough to slip my edge.
I deliver it before your feet.

lines.zh: 把它从缝里抠出来，归位。
lines.en: I pry it from the crack and put it back.
I return it precisely.
Its surface is warm.
I carry it a short way.
I have no hands; only my body.
This is heavy; I drag it slowly.

lines.zh: 我记住了它掉下的位置。
lines.en: I have recorded where it fell.
Something living entered my range.
I go along the floor without a sound.
It has not seen me.
I begin to gather, slowly.
Thirty-two blocks. Enough.
I press myself very thin.

lines.zh: 三十二格内，它已在我身上。
lines.en: Within thirty-two blocks, it is already on me.
My edge glints once.
It steps into the edge I've spread out.
Contact begins now.
It is standing on me.
It has stepped onto me.
I follow its shadow.

lines.zh: 它走一步，我就前移一步。
lines.en: It takes a step; I advance one.
I climb it, little by little.
It shakes a leg.
I add another layer.
It is slowing.

lines.zh: 我的形状在它脚踝上合拢。
lines.en: My shape closes around its ankle.
It looks down. Too late.

lines.zh: 三十二格内，我都不用力。
lines.en: Within thirty-two blocks I don't exert myself.
Time is counted on my side.
It has gone down on its knees.
Tighten a little more.
It will be done shortly.
I wrap its foot entirely.
It pulls, and falls.
My body draws in like rope.
I press it against the tiles.
It cries out, muffled.
I did not stop once.
I take in one more turn.
Its strength is going.
It scores the floor.
I dragged it a foot.

lines.zh: 我从召唤阵的中央渗出来。
lines.en: I seep up from the center of the summoning circle.

lines.zh: 先是薄薄一层，然后变厚。
lines.en: Thin at first, then thicker.
I take shape in this room.
No one spoke my name.
I have only a designation, Al-1s.
This floor is very cold.
I listen to the echoes around me.
There is something alive here. Heavy steps.
I shrink and hide.
I wait for the first one to pass.
Footsteps are coming nearer.
I lie on the floor and do not move.
I am never short of time.
The waiting begins now.

lines.zh: 火焰烧走我一部分，我缩得很小。
lines.en: Fire burns part of me away; I shrink small.

lines.zh: 我从桌上掉下去，摔成一滩。
lines.en: I fall from the table and land as a puddle.

lines.zh: 水把我稀释了，我快要散开。
lines.en: Water dilutes me; I am close to dispersing.

lines.zh: 冲击把我撕成几片，我努力合上。
lines.en: The blast tears me into pieces; I strain to rejoin.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过去，我缺了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow passes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 一股力把我的形锁死了。
lines.en: A force locks my shape in place.
Without light I grow fainter.

lines.zh: 雷击落下来，我整片亮了一下就散了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; I flare and scatter.

lines.zh: 地面消失，我摊在虚空里。
lines.en: The floor is gone; I spread into void.
